title: I
html_source:
Molly Bloom is the I and there are numerous parallels between her and Nora Barnacle, James Joyce’s wife !

Attitude to their daughter, romantic entanglements to someone called Mulvey, candid attitude to sex and so on demonstrate the autobiographical nature of Joyce’s work.
